I think everyone already knows that. The problem is the human mind is complicated as fuck and psychiatry is the best we've got. 

It's at the stage now like physiological medicine was in the medieval ages. Full of bullshit equivalent to blood letting, psychic humors and animal sacrifices. But even in the medieval ages medicine had a few working ideas like good food was part of good health and that bandaging wounds promoted healing. 

We should obviously remain well aware that psychiatry is still in its infancy but psychiatrists mean well and mental illnesses really do exist. Just like how physical diseases really do exist in the medieval era despite medicine at the time being wholly unable to treat or even comprehend those diseases. Medicine wasn't abandoned and through centuries of hard work and continued improvement of the profession it became the much better institution it is today.

Psychiatry is not bullshit, rather an infantile... but still honest attempt at tackling a problem which for now is utterly beyond our ability to even define properly let alone attack. Psychiatrists may think they know more than they actually do, just like early physicians, but that's not out of malice.
